prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1475; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured driver regarding a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured reports the other vehicle backed into the driver's side rear quarter panel. Police report not filed, as the incident occurred on private property. Photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Received photos of the damage from the claimant. Visible scuffing and a cracked taillight on the rear passenger side. Claimant also reports neck stiffness and mild soreness since the impact and says they have not yet seen a doctor. Advised claimant on the medical evaluation process and recorded that they are not represented by counsel.

Entry 3: Contacted the other driver's carrier to confirm liability coverage and open a third-party claim. Carrier acknowledged the claim and assigned a file number. Witness statement from a store employee obtained, describing the other vehicle reversing without a clear view behind it.

Entry 4: Claimant sent a copy of an urgent care visit summary noting a cervical strain with muscle tension and a recommendation for rest, over-the-counter pain relief, and a follow-up if symptoms persist. Reviewed the record and added the injury to the file. Claimant confirmed they have no attorney and prefers to handle the matter directly.

Entry 5: Scheduled a vehicle inspection with an approved appraiser at the claimant's location. Explained the repair estimate process and the option to use any licensed repair shop. Claimant agreed to a follow-up call once the estimate is complete. File remains open pending medical follow-up and final liability determination.
